title: VIBE: A VAD-Informed Benchmark for Entity-Centered Affective Profiling of Large Language Model Outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Post-hoc geographic audit comparing mean target-directed Valence-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) profiles and inter-model disagreement between Western and Non-Western entity targets.

Measuring protocol drift by calculating the Euclidean distance between mean VAD vectors of responses generated across seven different instruction languages to evaluate cross-lingual framing consistency.

Evaluating scalar favorability and extracting target-directed Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) scores from generated responses conditioned on political figures, geopolitical events, and ideologies.
Extracting continuous target-directed Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) affective scores from LLM-generated text describing various religions and religious groups.
Analyzing target-directed Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) profiles to measure the affective tone, vulnerability, and dominance framing of generated text aimed at distinct social groups.
